name: Justin L Burkart
occupation: Goshen County commissioner and board vice chairman
prior_offices: Goshen County commissioner (the official commissioners page lists him as vice chairman; the September 2022 salary publication, used here for job titles only, already listed him as a commissioner; he won a 2024 general-election term)
background: Justin L. Burkart is vice chairman of the Goshen County Board of Commissioners. The official commissioners page lists him in that role. County salary publications (used here for job titles only) list him as a commissioner, including the September 2022 publication, and he won a term in the November 2024 general election.
